priority2_post_ablation.upstream_caveat: Both with_post and no_post draw from rich.parquet, where upstream recording-level sosfiltfilt (ECG/resp) and HABS PREPROCESSED EEG (zero-phase FIR + full-recording Picard ICA) are shared.

ref_S07_no_post_nonfirst.note: 3-phase Ridge evaluated on non-first trials in session (i >= 1)

p3a_raw_idx_norm_direct.note: Raw normalized within-session trial index [0, 1], reset per (ID, day)

p3a_index_linear.note: OOF linear model on normalized session trial index

p3a_index_poly3.note: OOF cubic polynomial of session trial index

p3b_cohort_x_index_gbdt.note: OOF nonlinear GBDT on (cohort, idx_raw, idx_norm)

p3c_pre0_strict_eda_resp.note: Nominal pre-0 CURATED EDA/respiration; archival quality gates can use data through +5 s.

p3c_pre0_body_all.note: Pre-0 body [-3.5, 0) s (EDA+Resp+ECG; note ECG R-peak prominence uses [-5, 5) s)

p3c_pre0_multimodal.note: Pre-0 body + 30 e05_ref EEG features [-3, 0) s (EEG from HABS PREPROCESSED)

p3d_prev_trial_s07_all_trials.note: Unlabeled S07_no_post physiology of trial i-1 (+ is_first flag), evaluated on all trials

p3d_prev_trial_s07_nonfirst.note: Same prev-trial model restricted to non-first trials in session (i >= 1)

p3d_prev_trial_causal_nonfirst.note: Unlabeled causal pre-5s physiology of trial i-1, evaluated on non-first trials
